newsitem.title: CANADA: Ranger says well test flows 15,500 bpd.
newsitem.headline: Ranger says well test flows 15,500 bpd.

text.p: Ranger Oil Ltd said an extended well test at its 15-percent-owned Pierce Field site in the United Kingdom sector of the North Sea showed an average rate of 15,500 barrels of oil per day (bpd) from a single well.
It said a total of 1.18 million barrels were produced from the well, which has a high angle section of over 3,500 feet through the oil-bearing paleocene sand reservoir.
Ranger said it will continue studies leading to a development decision in 1997 with production of approximately 45,000 bpd commencing in the second or third quarter of 1998.

The Pierce field group is comprised of Britoil Plc, which owns 40 percent, Enterprise Oil Exploration at 31 percent, Ranger Oil (U.K.) Ltd with 15.6 percent, Agip (U.K.) Ltd, MOC Exploration (U.K.) Ltd, Santos Europe Ltd and BP Exploration Company Ltd.
